comparison.objective: Align a swiveling mop socket with its handle and push until the quick-connect button latches.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, coaxial insertion, and snap-latch engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Lug seated, spring button exposed through the window, assembly released and still; partial credit for incomplete insertion.
comparison.reason: Tests a single tight insertion and latch, not controlled agitation and many-body separation.
